subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Measuring Accessibility Maturity
description: A short lesson to help you apply Measuring Accessibility Maturity.

hook.text: A CEO asks: 'How accessible are we?' The team can only answer with anecdotes, not data.

buildup.text: Accessibility maturity models measure how deeply accessibility is embedded in process, culture, and technology.

discovery.text: Maturity levels range from ad hoc to optimized: reactive fixing, proactive design, and continuous improvement.

twist.text: High maturity means accessibility is in job descriptions, procurement criteria, and executive KPIs—not just test plans.

climax.text: A maturity assessment reveals the team is at level 2 of 5. A roadmap to level 4 is created with clear milestones.

punchline.text: Measure where you are. Plan where you're going. Track the journey.

quiz.question: What does high accessibility maturity mean?
options: Accessibility is embedded in processes, culture, and KPIs
